purpose: Section 4 (historical reproduction). Independently recomputes the two-event validation report's (commit 3047c45, NOT an ancestor of this branch) cited KG/OK metrics directly from raw artifacts present on this HEAD -- without trusting that disconnected branch's own claims. Confirms whether the historical model/backtest record this task's user described is real.
method: For each event: brier = mean((p_i - y_i)^2) over ALL predicted entrants (not just those matched to the official leaderboard) -- this exact denominator convention was reverse-engineered by testing it against KG's cited 0.00829809 until an EXACT match was found (0.008298090731878534), then reused unmodified for OK. log_loss = -ln(p_winner). topN_coverage = |actual topN finishers intersect predicted topN by the model's own probability field| / |actual topN|.
